items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-05
items.q: a band used to come out there called the Maple Leaf Band. That was with, uh, Freddie Kepert. He used to lead that band.

ctx.x: I was wondering about some of the bands you heard when you were a kid. When you were very young, before you even started playing. Do you remember any other than your father's band?

I mentioned the few I heard. As a matter of fact, I heard practically all of them because they used to come out there on that coast. Such as Sam Morgan, Chris Kelly, Riddick, Riddick, Riddick, Punch Miller. Uh, a band used to come out there called the Maple Leaf Band. That was with, uh, Freddie Kepert. He used to lead that band. And all those boys used to come out there. I used to hear them. Matter of fact, they used to have what you call a trolley ride from Biloxi to Peskristad. It hooked five or six, uh,…
Who was in your daddy's band? Did he have a band of his own or what?
